messages:
james_b: Hey team — trying to apply promo `REDWOODSPRING` during checkout, API returns 422 `promo_invalid_or_expired`. Dashboard still shows it as active until 2026-05-31. Can you check?
elysia_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact API request/response (no secrets) and the account email or org id? Also, any chance you used a different email/SSO alias? :thinking_face: 
james_b: Request snippet and error below. Email is james@acme.dev. We signed up directly (no SSO).
---
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/claim_promo \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \
  -d '{"code":"REDWOODSPRING","account_email":"james@acme.dev"}'
---
Response: 422 {"error":"promo_invalid_or_expired","message":"code invalid or expired","promo_code":"REDWOODSPRING"}
---
elysia_support: Thanks — can you also confirm whether the dashboard shows the code under your org's "Available offers" or under a partner grant? Screenshots (or copy-paste) help.
james_b: Dashboard shows: "REDWOODSPRING — Active until 2026-05-31 — 3 uses remaining — Scope: account"
elysia_support: Hmm. I'm going to try to repro on our side using a test account and the API with your promo id. One sec.
elysia_support: Attempting reproduction, posting logs. If anyone from eng can watch: @mina_eng @sam_sre
mina_eng: watching — paste any trace ids you get from the API, will grep service logs.
elysia_support: Trace header from response: `x-request-id: rq_2026-08-12_7f9a2b`
elysia_support: From promo service logs: `promo-service: claim_request id=rq_2026-08-12_7f9a2b code=REDWOODSPRING status=failed reason=expiry_check_failed promo_expires=2026-05-31T00:00:00-07:00`
mina_eng: Aha. Promo record expiry in DB stored with `-07:00` offset. Our expiry check internally normalizes to UTC and expects end-of-day UTC. There was a bug where partner-created promos could be stored with the originator's local offset and then compared incorrectly, making some codes appear expired if created in a non-UTC zone.
sam_sre: We saw a similar report last month, fix landed in promo-service but only rolled out to canary. Looks like this account hit a node that didn't have the fix yet. I'm on it.
elysia_support: Thanks. For immediate mitigation for James: can we manually grant equivalent trial credits to his account while we finish the rollout?
billing_ops: We can grant a temporary credit. Want to do the full promo amount (3 months dev credit) or a one-off $300 manual credit?
elysia_support: Customer expects the original 3-month trial. Let's grant equivalent credits and mark as investigational escalation.
billing_ops: Done — manual credit applied. Transaction id: TX-20260812-9987. Gave $300 credit and flagged for rollback if promo later applies.
elysia_support: @james_b I've applied a manual credit for $300 while we finish the fix. You should see it on your billing page under "Credits" > "Manual adjustments". Sorry for the friction. We'll follow up once promo-service fix is fully rolled out.
james_b: Thanks!! I see the credit. Appreciate fast help :raised_hands:
mina_eng: Follow-up: opened internal epic to ensure promo expiry normalization is enforced for all storage codepaths — linking logs and promo id: promo_8421. Will backfill any affected promos.
elysia_support: Created support ticket and linked the escalation: #SUP-2026-1847. ticket-bot: created support ticket SUP-2026-1847 for james@acme.dev, linked to incident INC-2026-998.
ticket-bot: Support ticket SUP-2026-1847 created by elysia_support and assigned to billing_ops.
sam_sre: Rolling the promo-service fix to stable now. ETA ~ 45m. I'll post when complete and we'll re-run claim flow for `REDWOODSPRING` then.
elysia_support: Next steps for customer: once we confirm the rollout, we'll attempt to reapply the promo on your account (no action needed from you). If it succeeds, we'll reverse the manual credit and reissue the promo grant. If it fails, we'll keep the manual credit and escalate further.
james_b: Sounds good. TY again.
elysia_support: Closing the loop here: promo-service fix fully rolled out, re-ran claim against `REDWOODSPRING` (promo id promo_8421) and claim now succeeds for james@acme.dev. We reversed manual credit TX-20260812-9987 and re-applied official promo grant id=grant_5581. Confirmed billing page shows promo discount applied.
james_b: Confirmed — promo applied and credit removed. All good. Thanks everyone. :tada:
